title: Vision transformers for diabetic retinopathy grading from retinal fundus photographs
abstract: We fine-tune vision transformer architectures to grade diabetic retinopathy severity on fundus photographs. The model detects early-stage lesions including microaneurysms and haemorrhages, and is compared against convolutional neural networks on a public retinal image dataset.

title: Deep learning for automated screening of diabetic retinopathy
abstract: Convolutional neural networks were trained on retinal images to screen for referable diabetic retinopathy. Sensitivity and specificity were evaluated in a clinical screening programme.

title: Convolutional networks for pneumonia detection in chest X-ray images
abstract: We train a convolutional neural network to detect pneumonia in chest radiographs and report early detection performance across hospitals.

title: Vision transformers at scale for image recognition
abstract: Transformer architectures are applied directly to sequences of image patches and match convolutional networks on large natural image benchmarks such as ImageNet.

title: Early fault detection in power transformer windings using dissolved gas analysis
abstract: Power transformer failures are costly. We present an early detection scheme for winding faults based on dissolved gas analysis and thermal models of oil-filled transformers.

title: Nitrogen uptake efficiency in winter wheat under drought stress
abstract: Field trials measured soil nitrogen availability and crop yield across irrigation regimes in winter wheat cultivars.
